appearance_reflections.likely_cause_or_limitation: The evidence supports a first-screen visibility problem for the requested sections, not a pure absence of interactive code. The site does contain some interaction in the Products and News views, but those interactions were not reachable from the homepage the tester saw.
appearance_reflections.preventative_action: Make the main page responsive and ensure interactive sections are visible and usable from the first screen, not hidden behind unreachable navigation. Verify that the rendered page adapts to different widths and exposes at least one interactive control that can be used immediately.
appearance_reflections.verification: Resize the page and confirm the layout adapts, then confirm an interactive control is visible and usable on the first screen.
appearance_reflections.transfer_limits: Applies to responsive company websites and product pages that should expose interactive content without extra discovery steps.
